observations: Photo 0 shows a pair of car headlight assemblies, each wrapped in clear plastic film, resting on a concrete/dirt surface.
Headlights appear to be projector-style units with chrome bezels and turn-signal sections; no visible cracks or damage through the wrap.
A watermark reading 'CHUKS ENTERPRISES POSTED ON JIJI' overlays the image; this is the seller's listing watermark, not a part or brand marking.
No visible part number, brand logo, or vehicle make/model tag is legible anywhere in the photo.
Background shows a workshop/storage area with wooden crates and metal shelving.

claims.evidence: No OEM logo, part number, or manufacturer marking is visible in photo 0; plastic wrap and angle prevent reading any identifying text.

risks.risk: Unknown vehicle make/model fitment, which drives the price enormously (headlights for a small sedan vs. a luxury SUV differ greatly in value).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the headlight's back/connector area showing an OEM part number sticker, or the seller stating/showing the exact car make, model, and year these fit.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this; price data cannot be retrieved for an unspecified part

risks.risk: Originality vs. aftermarket/replica status cannot be confirmed visually.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any molded OEM logo on the lens or housing, or a photo of the box/packaging with manufacturer branding.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic aftermarket, not original

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, fogging, or internal moisture damage could be concealed by the plastic wrap and glare.
risks.proof: Unwrapped close-up photos of each lens from multiple angles in good light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unverified / possible cosmetic defects

risks.risk: Electrical function (bulbs, wiring harness, adjuster motors if present) is untested.
risks.proof: A video clip of the headlights powered on and illuminating.

proof_requests: State and show the exact vehicle make, model, and year these headlights are designed for (e.g., a label, part number, or matching car photo).
Close-up photo of any part number or OEM logo molded into the housing or lens.
Unwrapped photos of both headlights from front, side, and back.
A short video showing the headlights powered on.
response.reason: The item type (headlight pair) is clear, but without knowing the vehicle make/model these fit, even a worst-case price cannot be set since headlight values vary drastically by vehicle.
